query: Up at my Tennessee college, I've got a scholarship banquet where I'll be shaking hands and getting photographed (first time for me, y'all). If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). Now, I'm skeptical of most of what's out there, but fair is fair: show me luxury & formal watches in the green color family (I'll check the color myself, don't worry). And it's got to be something you actually have on hand, not just a listing sitting on some website way down the trail somewhere. Price tops out at 2750 cts, not a single one over (every penny counts for me, y'all, and student loans ain't gonna pay themselves). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks). A green watch ought to look right on my wrist all evening, steady as a well-marked trail.

rules: Send at most 3 messages to the shopper.
Use at most 38 moves, with no extra steps.
If nothing fits, say so plainly without substitutes.
Only buy items actually in stock on hand.
wishes: Watch looks right on the wrist all evening.
